component.name: Stave
component.summary: Design furniture in words and check it can be built

description.p: Stave is woodworking design for beginners. A project is a short text file that says what the parts are, what wood they are cut from and how they are joined. Stave shows the design in 3D and checks it the way a compiler checks a program: parts that run into each other, a door that hits a side when it swings, a joint that a tool you have can't cut.

ul.li: See the design in 3D, open its doors and drawers, and pull it apart along its joints
Focus on one joint or piece of hardware to see how it goes together
Problems pinned where they happen, each with a plain explanation and a way to fix it
Edit by clicking in the 3D view or in the text, side by side

screenshot.caption: A clothing cabinet, with one door's hinge stile selected
